name: Python: PCEP-30-02 Certified Entry-Level Python Programmer (Python Institute)
material_vintage: OpenEDG Python Institute PCEP-30-02 exam syllabus (status ACTIVE, page last updated 23 Feb 2022), fetched live on 2026-09-26 from pythoninstitute.org/pcep-exam-syllabus and itemised in full: every sub-point of objectives 1.1-4.4 is one item. Exam format (30 items; single-select, multiple-select, code and scenario items; pass = cumulative 70%) and block weights (18/29/25/28%) are from the same page. The Python Institute has announced a routine version refresh of PCEP for Q3 2026 whose syllabus was not yet published on 2026-09-26; built on 30-02 by the library owner's decision, the daily live recheck will flag the new version. The Python Institute publishes no past papers: every practice and test item here is original, written to the published objectives and item types. Exam-dump sites were deliberately not used. Every code-output answer key was generated by actually running the code (Python 3).
level_source: standalone: a vendor certification with no RQF/FHEQ level

learner_notices.text: This course is built on PCEP-30-02. The Python Institute has scheduled a routine refresh of the PCEP exam for the third quarter of 2026. If you plan to sit the real exam, check the version code when you book; the topics are expected to stay the same, and this course will be updated if the new syllabus changes anything.
